# E0120: the lineage does not declare a field every lineage has

Every lineage declares a name and its schemas. This one declares no name. The
primary position is the lineage itself.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0120]: the lineage does not declare name
 --> lineage.cue:1:1
  |
1 | schemas: {
  | ^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: every lineage declares name and schemas
```
